name: Llewellyn Vaughan-Lee
reason: No longer teaches: his own page at The Golden Sufi Center (goldensufi.org/about/llewellyn-vaughan-lee/, robots.txt read) says he gave his final lectures in late 2018 and stepped back from public teaching; his son Emmanuel Vaughan-Lee now leads the centre. Otherwise strong (30+ books, audio/video library, contact@goldensufi.org, Point Reyes Station CA), so the owner may prefer to list him for his books and recordings, or list The Golden Sufi Center or Emmanuel Vaughan-Lee instead.
